Name: Barley's Springer Spaniel Dog
Author: BarleyZP
Description:
[size=4]Content[/size][size=4]
[/size]
[size=3]This mod adds a new dog breed, an English Springer Spaniel, inspired by my childhood dog![/size][size=4]

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lisyce/StardewValleyMods/refs/heads/main/%5BCP%5D%20Springer%20Spaniel/SpriteSample.png[/img]
[/size][size=2](The body shapes are heavily based on the existing vanilla dogs, so credit of course to ConcernedApe for those sprites I've based my work upon.)[/size][size=4]

﻿Configuration
[/size][size=3]
This mod is compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]. You can configure which vanilla dog you'd like to replace with the new sprites, or choose to add it as its own breed.

From left to right, the vanilla dogs are numbered 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, so choosing to replace dog 2 with the spaniel will replace the existing vanilla spaniel in the middle with the new dog sprites.

[img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/a/a4/Dog_1.png[/img]﻿[img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/b/bb/Dog_2.png[/img][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/f/fc/Dog_3.png[/img][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/f/f7/Dog_4.png[/img][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/a/a3/Dog_5.png[/img]

You can also optionally change the adoption price of the spaniel. By default, it is the same price as the other vanilla dogs (40,000 gold).[/size]
